subject: STABLE c6t-rca-opus #8 + HEAVY RELEASE: cross-attachment framebuffer fetch -> pass-MRT tile job by default; all gates green (integration = known CA 66/42 only)
body: Shared tree, uncommitted: render_encoder.inc 1b21226b (tegu_render_pass_mrt_enabled tri-state + tegu_render_pass_mrt_cross_fetch: default admits only genericMrt 2..4-target pipelines, one active target, whose FS input attachments include a non-main attachment; NORD2_METAL_PASS_MRT=1 all as before, =0 none; -DTEGU_PASS_MRT_CROSS_FETCH_DEFAULT=0 build-time off), render_pipeline.inc 8596bcc2 (AIR scope set/reset around tegu_render_variant_pass_mrt_compile; incl. air-render-plan's AIR-plan content), NEW tests/pass_mrt_cross_fetch_test.py e6a5b46f. Also in tree from #7: bridge a98f7e6f, render_resources 582e4a26. Works on AIR-planned facts modules (air_facts_module declares SubpassData + InputAttachmentIndex, PMX pipe subpass mask 3/2). New test (real AIR/Mali host libs, real frontend+bridge, fake kernel, device render defines): a-131 (reads own rt0 + rt1, the C6t 'memfetch' break class) 24 draws 24 -> 1 GPU job, a-216 (reads rt1 only; was already a batched texel fetch) 1 -> 1, every draw TEGU_PASS_MRT rc=0 rts=2 (24/24), no command/draw failures, NORD2_METAL_PASS_MRT=0 reproduces the old path. Gates (nice 10, jobs1): run_host_tests (NORD2_AIR_LLVM_BIN=/usr/bin, SCOPE=compilers) rc=0 incl. iOS strict link; CA host test PASS 47 (asan+release); render harness rc=0; texture_format PASS; integration --candidate 1005 checks, only the known CoreAnimation pass 66/42. Note: of the 19 tile-refused variants, 15 read only the unwritten attachment and were already batched (texel fetch of its memory); the job-count win is the 4 that also read their own target. Not device-tested; pass-MRT LD_TILE of a loaded unwritten target has no hardware evidence yet.
